checks.checks: exact state bytes including signed zero; time; data generation; external data; flags; ordered additional anchors; foreign data; history; alpha; residual options; coverage tripwire

reuse.row_counter_scope: scoped point/derivative requests; fixed reconstruction and surface catalogs counted separately
reuse.lifetime: immutable fixed catalogs per patch; exact-state, moving-row and owned-profile caches per evaluation scope

immutable_rows.reuse_distance_scope: requests since previous resident access/construction, not exact LRU stack distance; no unbounded key trace; histogram final bin is capped
immutable_rows.distinct_keys: not counted exactly: peak residency lower bound; misses upper bound, including reconstruction
immutable_rows.accounting: conservative capacities/allocation overhead; all catalog-created shared rows live through eviction; bypass/caller-value copies are transient RSS

checks.comparison_mode: only structural policy Off/PatchExactV1; ExactStepV1 in both

scope: synthetic/read-only native rows; altered displacement tests identity only, never a case/height candidate
